dataset: bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us (NEAR's public BigQuery dataset, NEAR Public Lakehouse silver tables)
run_utc: 2026-11-12, between 22:00 and 22:15 UTC (queries 1-3), about 22:45 UTC (query 4) and 23:29 UTC (query 5); query 6 on 2026-11-13 about 02:35 UTC
how: each query was run once in the BigQuery console (sandbox, no billing). Queries 1-4: the result's JSON view was turned into CSV in the browser, its SHA-256 taken there, and the file written here and checked against that SHA-256. Query 5: the console's own CSV export (Save results, through Google Drive), downloaded and copied here unchanged; its SHA-256 is of that file
check: The SHA-256 is taken after the browser step, so it ties these files to this repository, not to BigQuery. To check them against BigQuery, run the six files in sql/ (any Google account; about 511 GB, inside the free monthly terabyte) and compare row by row; the job IDs are private to the project that ran them.
